faq.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to know about Kere.
faq.q1: How do I place a custom clothing order?
faq.a1: Browse the marketplace to find a tailor whose style matches yours, or use our custom designer to describe exactly what you want. Then submit your order and we'll connect you with the right tailor.
faq.q2: What if the finished item doesn't fit?
faq.a2: Every order includes a free revision. If there's a fit issue, your tailor will adjust it at no extra cost. If you're still not satisfied, we offer a full refund.
faq.q3: How long does an order take?
faq.a3: Most orders are completed within 5–14 business days depending on complexity. You'll see the estimated delivery time before confirming your order.
faq.q4: Can I provide my own measurements?
faq.a4: Yes! Our customization forms let you enter exact measurements (chest, waist, hips, length, inseam) in centimeters for a perfect fit.
faq.a5: Yes. We deliver to all major cities across Georgia. Delivery time may vary by location.
faq.q6: How do I become a tailor on Kere?
faq.a6: Click "Sign In" in the navigation and choose the tailor option. Our team will review your application and onboard you within 2–3 business days.
